API:
export type CoverageStatus = { kind: 'record'; key: string } | { kind: 'child-of'; key: string } | { kind: 'ignored'; reason: string } | { kind: 'known-gap'; beadId: string } | { kind: 'unaccounted' }
export interface SourceCoverageEntry { item: SourceInventoryItem; status: CoverageStatus }
export function evaluateSourceCoverage(inventory, records: readonly {kind,key,name}[], rules): readonly SourceCoverageEntry[]
export class SourceInventoryCoverageError extends Error (lists unaccounted items with page numbers)
Rules = ordered list of predicates: ignoreRule(reasonCode, predicate), knownGapRule(beadId, predicate), childOfRule(key, predicate). Name auto-match runs first: normalized item text == record name (case-insensitive, hyphen/quote-normalized) => record:<key>. Tier 'chapter'/'section' headings auto-ignored as 'document-structure' unless they match a record.
